title: Absolute Petersson integrability on a translated modular domain
statement: Let Δ be any finite-index subgroup of SL₂(ℤ), viewed in GL₂(ℝ) by the canonical embedding. Let r∈SL₂(ℤ) and f,g∈CuspForm Δ 2. Put μ=dx dy/y² on ℍ, F₀={z∈ℍ : 1≤|z|² and |Re z|≤1/2}, and P(f,g)(z)=conjugate(f(z))g(z)(Im z)². Then P(f,g) is μ-integrable on rF₀.
lean_statement: ∀ (Δ : Subgroup (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ)) [Δ.FiniteIndex] (r : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) (f g : CuspForm Δ 2), MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (UpperHalfPlane.petersson 2 f g) ((fun z : UpperHalfPlane => r • z) '' ModularGroup.fd) (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane)
